title: BBK BBK Worker return v1
x-bbk-requirements: Return one `bbk.role-return.v1` object with `contract` = `bbk.worker-result.v1`, `role` = `bbk_worker`, an allowed `invocation_mode`, an allowed `return_kind`, an allowed `operational_disposition`, and `semantic_state.name` = `work_unit_execution_state` with an allowed `semantic_state.value`. Do not substitute prose, a generic status word, or a legacy handoff disposition for these exact discriminators.

`READY_FOR_PARENT_INTEGRATION` requires current governing sources and invocation; complete assigned outputs; exact in-scope artifact and effect accounting; every persisted outcome-bearing bundle finalized or explicitly sealed and read-only verified by the BBK artifact package engine with exact identity, manifest digest, and receipts attached; satisfied or explicitly non-applicable WorkUnit completion checks; no silent substitution, unauthorized effect, ownership collision, unresolved governing decision, required capability gap, ambiguous cleanup, or stale checkpoint; and a verified durable result and handoff. It authorizes only parent inspection and integration of the contribution.

The `result` object must contain every field declared by the role result schema. Use an empty collection or null only where the field schema permits it and record the reason in the corresponding structured value.

Bind exact or substantial artifacts and evidence through verified durable references. A conversational summary, transport receipt, confident claim, or host task status is not a substitute for the required result and evidence carriers.

No Worker return, including operational `COMPLETE` or `READY_FOR_PARENT_INTEGRATION`, can freeze or accept a candidate, conclude a prototype, establish independent assertion satisfaction, close a finding or issue, accept risk, complete a territory or campaign, authorize deployment or publication, or grant release.
This return is governed by `spec/contracts/catalog.json`, the common `bbk.role-return.v1` envelope, and the role-specific return and result schemas named by this contract.
